changelog:
- Initial release of the "remember-customer-names" skill.
- Enables agents to store and retrieve customer names, roles, companies, and personal details to personalize conversations.
- Supports building, recalling, and updating identity cards via BlueColumn API (API key required).
- Provides clear conversation workflow and example API calls for integration.
- Detailed API usage and documentation links included.
summary: Never blank on a customer again — names, roles, companies, and the details that make conversations personal. Use when an agent talks to customers and should address them correctly and remember their context. Requires a BlueColumn API key (bc_live_*).
